'''Cjaalysce'I starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cjaalysce'I]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The home of the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]], the starport took up a whole corner of the city.<ref name="BSS" />
